observations: Photo 0: A large industrial sewing machine on a white table with a red front panel. The machine is beige/grey, with a large pulley and metal arm. A red box with small parts is on the left. The table has a ruler on the right edge.

Photo 1: Same angle as photo 0, slightly different lighting. The machine appears to be in a workshop or outdoor setting. The table surface is white with a red front panel. A spool of thread is visible on the right.

Photo 2: Close-up of the machine head, showing a red oval logo with 'CNET' written in white. The needle and presser foot are visible. The machine is on a white table with a ruler on the right. The background shows grass and a wooden structure.

Photo 3: Close-up of the motor under the machine. It is a large, ribbed, grey metal motor with a pulley system. The motor is mounted on a metal bracket. The background shows a green bucket and a wooden post.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI UNYIME EZEKIEL' and 'TECNO SPARK 10c'.
